hypotheses.justification: The other hypotheses already give `T2Space G`, and Mathlib finds it by typeclass inference. `TotallyDisconnectedSpace.t1Space` (Mathlib/Topology/Separation/Connected.lean:22) gives `T1Space G`, and therefore `T0Space G`. `IsTopologicalGroup.regularSpace` (Mathlib/Topology/Algebra/Group/Pointwise.lean:385) gives `RegularSpace G` from `[Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]` alone. The instance `instT3Space [T0Space X] [RegularSpace X] : T3Space X` (Separation/Regular.lean:443) then gives `T3Space G`, and the chain `T3Space → T25Space → T2Space` gives `T2Space G`. So after `omit [T2Space G] in`, the call to `quotientMapOfLE_exists_continuous_section_of_isClosed`, which needs `[T2Space G]`, still gets that instance from inference. The rest of the proof (`quotientBotHomeomorph`, `simp`) is unchanged. Degenerate cases do not matter: the statement and proof are the same, and only where the instance comes from changes.
